games.name: Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator
Shelterra the Skyworld
games.summary: Explore a floating continent in a fantasy JRPG! Journey across an open world, conquer dungeons in turn-based battles, learn new skills by fighting enemies, and summon powerful Artifacts to aid you. Uncover the secrets of the Skyworld and save Shelterra from falling!

games.name: A World of Keflings - Which Witch
AMMO DUMP
games.summary: A first-person incremental shooter about one cube. Shoot it until it breaks and a bigger one slams down from the sky. Grab rounds from the ammo piles, chase bullseyes and gold cubes, and grow a skill tree from one pistol to lightning storms, turrets, meteors and a sun.

games.name: ASCEND: The Forgotten Road
games.summary: Walk the Forgotten Road as the Construct, an artificial warrior with an impossible Core. Fight through three lost lands in a hard-but-fair third-person action roguelike: master four weapons, fuse elemental rewards into evolutions and return from every fall a little stronger.

games.name: Aveos
games.summary: Rediscover the classic feel of linear APRGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

games.name: Bannerborn
games.summary: Build an unlikely army and push it to absurd extremes. Recruit troops, fuse their abilities, stack powerful upgrades, and watch your plans erupt into battle. Take on a branching fantasy expedition solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

games.name: Biffo
games.summary: Biffo's package holiday has dumped him in a jungle with nothing but his slippers, a Hawaiian shirt and a bottle of ale. Twenty bars, one loyalty card, free pints for life, and an endless roguelike Pub Crawl for afters. A Proper British Platforming Adventure.

games.name: Black Hole Surfers
games.summary: Black Hole Surfers is a short incremental action game about surfing the edge of a black hole while dodging asteroids, collecting resources and avoiding being dragged in yourself! Upgrade your weapons systems, shields, engines and more as you jump from sector to sector, trying to find your way home.

games.name: Black King's Defense
games.summary: Build a maze out of chess pieces and defend your king in this Tower Defense take on the timeless classic, Chess! Pawns, rooks, bishops, knights and queens strike by their own moves as the white army marches across a 3D board, through a full hand balanced campaign.

games.name: BLACKBOX (gohyaku)
games.summary: BLACKBOX blends poker strategy with market trading in a high-stakes simulation. Build powerful hands, make calculated trades, and manage risk as every card combination influences your profits and losses. Chase big gains—but one decision can change everything.

games.name: Blocky Battles
games.summary: Build your house faster and better than your rivals, then see if it can survive the wind! Compete in short multiplayer matches, climb the ranks, unlock rewards, and prove that your construction deserves to be called a fortress.

games.name: Boss After Boss
games.summary: Castle Builder let you construct castles, keeps and temples. You can bring down your castles with catapult stones and destructive magics, you can even fire the cow'tapult and moo the castle down! See how high a score you can get when you let the destructive forces loose.Featuring:-6 animated humans and orcs.-12 detailed housing objects.-10 block types, each with twenty different textures made in a new, cool cartoon look.Castles can be saved locally on your device or be shared with others on the Internet.Your castles will have the special toy builder look you are used to getting from Ettin Entertainment line of builder games.

games.name: Box Flow
games.summary: Box Flow is a cozy incremental packing puzzle where you scan, pack, seal, label, and ship orders while unlocking perks, automation, bigger boxes, contracts, and endless warehouse challenges.

games.name: Campfire Harmony
games.summary:
An adorable fox lives on your desktop, reacting to your typing to keep a campfire burning. 

Earn coins, upgrade, and decorate a lakeside camp in a transparent overlay. 

Cozy, zero-stress companion for work or study.

games.name: Carry On Together
games.summary: Carry On Together is an online co-op moving game for up to 4 players, where you build a small delivery company with your friends and every job can turn into chaos. Break the furniture, crash the truck, lose all your earnings or hold it together as a team. Can you keep the company alive?

games.name: Case Opened
games.summary: Roguelike-style game that opens up with your own collection. Open cases, roll wears for all weapons, get their unique skin, and beat the appraisal value in 24 levels. Collect Adhesives to use in your Master Key and have and retain all weapons that you collect through the game. No cash transactions.

games.name: CatVac
games.summary: Catvac is a cozy 3D cat-collecting adventure. Daze wild cats, vacuum them up with your Catvac 3000, and use their abilities to open new areas on your way to rescue your catnapped cat Bubba. Over fifty cats to find, casino, amusement park, and so much more to explore!

games.name: CHAOS: Dread Manifest
games.summary: CHAOS: Dread Manifest: A psychological-horror RPG set in a decaying and violent world.

games.name: Choice of Life: Modern Ages - Wallpapers
CloserLook VR: Oldways
games.summary:
CloserLook VR: Oldways invites you into a painstakingly crafted modern West African world, where you awaken as Tessy, a final-year student trapped in a university building steeped in secrets. 

As you search for an escape, each puzzle becomes a thread in a larger conspiracy, guiding you from quiet libraries to hidden temples while the shadow of a mysterious organization grows closer.

games.name: Cobble Climber
games.summary: Cobble climber is a difficult climbing game where each hold has a countdown. Taking too long will increase the risk of drowning in the rising water level.

games.name: Corporate Dash
games.summary: Corporate Dash is a hilarious party racing game for 2–9+ players! Use your smartphones to place bets, play sneaky cards, and watch your office colleagues race through hilarious chaos. Outsmart your friends, survive unexpected disasters, and climb the corporate ladder!

games.name: Definitely Not Poker
games.summary: It’s not poker, even though it might look like it. Enjoy a new twist on the classic Texas Hold’Em thanks to DNP. In this game, the standard cards aren’t the only ones that matter. Your hand and the special community cards can change the course of the game in a matter of seconds!

games.name: Delveport
games.summary: Build a thriving fantasy harbor, recruit and equip a growing roster of heroes, and push through increasingly dangerous dungeon expeditions in this progression-focused incremental RPG.

games.name: Doner verkaufen
games.summary: A satirical, entertaining kebab-selling game with a 2D look. Remember the order and fill it. But don't give too much—or your boss will get mad—and don't give too little—or your customer will get mad.

games.name: Dungeon Node
games.summary: Dungeon Node is a pixel-art action RPG where you battle relentless hordes, recruit mercenaries, and choose skill nodes to shape your growth. Journey from the forest to the depths of Hell, facing stronger enemies and new choices as you venture deeper.

games.name: Echoes of Calir
games.summary: Echoes of Calir is a turn-based 1v1 mix of chess, a TCG and a board game on an 8×8 board. Build a deck of five units and five terrain cards, place them before battle, and outmaneuver your opponent through movement, abilities, and captures. Chess rules with the strategic depth of a TCG.

games.name: Excuse Me, King!
games.summary: Talk your way out of trouble in this party game for 2–8 players! Improvise excuses, work surprise words into your story, and let your friends rate the results. Play together on one PC or online through Steam. External voice chat is required for online play.

games.name: Fantasy Psychological Defense Course
games.summary: A first-person exam simulator: pass by observing, remembering and deducing.

games.name: Feedmaster
games.summary: Feedmaster is a strategy game about recommendations. Study users’ interests and emotions, turn creators, ads, and ideas into posts they’ll like, then combine users, tags, and traits to meet rising weekly goals and convert clicks. Where users—and the world—end up is something to worry about later.

games.name: Fish With Friends (Lake Country Games)
games.summary: Fish With Friends is a cozy online fishing world for 1–8 players. Relax solo or fish with friends, chase records, compete in comps, build your collection, and cause harmless chaos with goofy physics, wild boat rides, playful fights, and fishing rod pranks.

games.name: Fleets of Valor
games.summary: "So simple to use this app is perfect for even the youngest iPadder… Ride a Pony is a brilliant app to use with young children and can be used to develop listening skills... Totally child friendly with no spoken or written text and no buttons or icons to complicate things... games.name: Football Manager: Auto Chess
games.summary: A football management game mixed with collection career play. You manage a themed club, schedule training, recruitment and league fixtures, then drag coach cards to command near-realtime matches as you climb from lower leagues to bigger stages.

games.name: Get It Free
games.summary: An idle cultivation game on your desktop. Start as a street thief: auto-spot targets, steal loot, auction it. Learn chain stealing, invisibility, time-stop. Explore the Shadow Market, run an auction house and knock-off workshop, rise to the highest heavens—until anything can be stolen.

games.name: Gregoire Lefebvre Investigations : The Vow of Hate
Grégoire Lefèbvre Investigations : The Vow of Hate
Grimoire of Blanks
games.summary: Every spell is unfinished. The consequences aren’t. Fill the blanks with words, twist sentences into devastating combos, and survive alone or with friends in this 1–4 player roguelite deckbuilder.

games.name: Gun Restoration Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run a gun restoration workshop. Take in damaged firearms, dismantle them, and craft missing parts using various tools. Unlock advanced machinery, restore each weapon to its former glory. Track demand, negotiate prices, and run a successful restoration business.

games.name: Hacker Plan
games.summary: Are you a person who likes numbers? Having fun with addition, subtraction, multiplication or division?Then you should try Numble!It is a funny game in which you can challenge your friends or choose a challenger random.Each match consists of three rounds. In each round you have 2 minutes in which you need to find the greatest number of combinations on the board: 2 numbers (operands) + operator + 1 number (result).For each combination is assigned a score which varies according to the complexity of the combination.The winner is to score the highest score over the three rounds.Great graphics and good sound effect makes the game more captivating.E 'can play the round when you want.In addition, you can practice single game where there is the challenger.Test your math skills.Play Numble!!

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Get ready for a big, colourful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Cluedo Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

games.name: Hellmouth
games.summary: Hellmouth is a bullet hell top-down shooter that drops you right in the middle of post-industrial hell. Blast through hordes of demons, create unique upgrades, and hopefully escape?!

games.name: Heroes of Aetheria: Crystal Siege
games.summary: Enjoy the Easter holidays with Easter Scratchers - Play loads of fun Easter themed games on your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch.= FEATURES = ? 15 different Easter games? Level-up to unlock games? The fun and excitement of scratch card games? FREE daily bonus? Super simple but addictive game play

games.name: Hidden Cat Islands
games.summary: Mini Bubble is a classic bubble shooter game. Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color and score points.

games.name: High Voltage
games.summary: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game where you build and expand a power grid across a beautiful island. Generate electricity, connect infrastructure, earn money, unlock new technology, and grow a small local grid into a massive energy network.

games.name: Hking's Block Arena
games.summary: Up to twelve cube robots, one grid, one shot then reload. A couch-first party shooter: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, King of the Hill, Juggernaut and Gun Game - up to 8 players on one screen, online with friends over Steam, or against bots.

games.name: I Only Moved My Mouse
games.summary: Any warehouse manager would kill for a heavy-duty hero like this to move the goods. So many crates to stack, so little time. But when you happen to have a forklift with a magnetic arm, moving boxes goes a lot faster. Unfortunately, warehouses of the future can be tricky to navigate. Solve this puzzle game's secrets to load up the truck on each level. Forklifts are easy to operate...right? The packages are ready to be loaded onto the truck, all you have to do is get them there. Move your loader, pick up the boxes, and stack them on the truck to succeed in this puzzle game. It's not as easy as it sounds solve sequence codes, avoid obstacles and treat delicate packages carefully! Complete each taxing task to become the ultimate loader. The madcap machine is back with many more physics puzzles to solve. These trucks aren't gonna load themselves! Break out a can of elbow grease and start moving the crates.

games.name: IdleOS
games.summary: A terminal-inspired idle game where every command brings you one step closer to hacking increasingly difficult targets. Mine resources, crack passwords, decode caches, and upgrade your operation as you progress toward more valuable rewards to upgrade your OS and become an unstoppable hacker.

games.name: It Takes One To Gnome It All
games.summary: Darkness is spreading through the forest, corrupting everything in its path. And somehow, it's up to you, a small regular gnome, to turn the tides. Fight against the odds and grow stronger while uncovering the secrets behind the corruption.

games.name: It Will Open
games.summary: You are a newly hired night-shift employee at the Arden Hotel. While controlling access to the parking lot and responding to guest complaints, you begin to experience a series of suspicious and disturbing events. Uncover the secret hidden within the hotel—and survive.

games.name: Jewelry Keeper
games.summary: Try to jump as many times as you can and try not to fall down. The higher you go the more points you get. After the game is over  and your score is bigger than your highscore a pop up shows up with your new highscore. You can share your score in facebook to compete with your friends.Get the highest score amoung your friends!

games.name: KESSLER: Orbital Incremental
games.summary: 1983: a killer satellite is put into orbit, then forgotten. 2041: it wakes up, and everything circling the Earth becomes a target. One shot, a cloud of debris, a chain reaction. An incremental pixel-art game where you set off the Kessler syndrome.

games.name: King in the Mountain
games.summary: A calm strategic incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall between expeditions. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

games.name: KOLUN
games.summary: This is a sliding/tile puzzle game especially for kids, but it can be enjoyable for the whole family!This game challenges the player to slide the pieces of an image to their original place to recreate the image. You can choose from different cars, motorbikes, airplanes and difficulty levels.** Try it for free NOW for a limited time! **Features:* Many nice car, motor, airplane, etc. pictures* 6 different difficulty levels - enjoyable for to whole family* Collect stars* Immediate restart* Change difficulty during play

games.name: Legacybound
games.summary: You are on a Ninja and you need to jump over the obstacles.  How far can you run? FEATURES ? Beautiful Graphics ? Fun Obstacles ? Earn Different Characters ? Game

games.name: Les enquêtes de Grégoire Lefèbvre : Le Serment de Haine Soundtrack
Let It Melt
games.summary: A cozy snow-melting idle game. Kids roll snowballs, your torch melts them, and every drop of water buys more helpers. Balance snow, heat and collection, fill tanker trucks, go home to grow your talent tree, and face the mud troll.

games.name: LetterZ: The Paths of Letters
games.summary: LetterZ: The Paths of Letters - is an automation game where you extract, transport, and assemble letters to form words. Optimize your production lines, unlock new possibilities, and build your factory, one letter at a time.

games.name: Leviathan: Rhino
games.summary: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

games.name: Mamka Said
games.summary: Dru returns for her childhood belongings. Mamka wants a thank-you. A child knows things Dru can't remember... and the room keeps making her smaller. A short psychological horror visual novel about gratitude, uncertain memory, and the right to leave.

games.name: Match & Ruin
games.summary: Plan the flow of cards across three mercenaries' hands in a roguelike card battler. Match ranks or suits to set up the next attack, defense, or skill. Reshape the shared deck and combine relics to fight through fallen kingdoms.

games.name: Mind the Clown: Reborn
games.summary: Can you get the rubber duckies not kill you?Prove you have the fastest  Pecos West finger through this fun and addictive application.Get the highest score and become the number one world ranking.Features of Shooting Ducks:- Thousands of Plastic ducks- Plastic ducks in multiple colors- World Ranking- Hundreds of hours of free entertainment- Unlimited Addiction

games.name: MISTWAKE
games.summary: Shipwrecked on a fogbound island, survive through cards, crafting and careful travel. Restore emergency communications, reopen the old harbor and mark a safe channel. Reach the rescue boat alive within the pickup window.

games.name: My Little Garden
games.summary: My Little Garden is a cozy incremental gardening game where you plant crops, combine unique plant effects, complete contracts, and unlock powerful upgrades. Automate your garden, earn gold while you are away, and grow your humble plot into a thriving farm.

games.name: Mystic Fog Maze
games.summary: A casual puzzle game where the player navigates through endless mazes surrounded by a mysterious fog.

games.name: No One Runs Alone
games.summary: No One Runs Alone is a chaotic multiplayer survival game where you and your team are bound together by the Soulbinder. Outsmart the Hunter, grab powerful perks, adapt to wild game modes, and make every escape a hilarious fight for survival.

games.name: No One Runs Alone - Support Pack
No One to See - Pinebark Camp
games.summary: Going through a hard time, Ethan decided to go camping alone in the Pinebark woods. He wanted to get away from everything for a few days and find a little silence. He just didn't expect that, in Pinebark, the silence would be listening too.

games.name: Nutshot Simulator
games.summary: Throw things. Hit people in the nuts. That's the whole game.Welcome to Nutshot Simulator — a comedy physics shooting gallery where the only objective is to wind up, let fly, and connect with a satisfying boomph. Every hit triggers a fully simulated ragdoll and a slow-mo replay of the consequences. There's no score and no clock. There's just the throw.Clear the cove, one wince at a timeEvery location is packed with a cast of oddballs, and your job is to work through them all. Make your way across Kumquat Cove — a golden-hour backyard trampoline, a greasy 90s burger joint, a fluorescent-lit doctor's office, a glass-tank aquarium, a hard-hat construction site, a Venice Beach boardwalk, a Sunday-morning church, a roaring music festival, and more. Keep your eyes open: some victims are secret targets tucked where you'd never think to throw, and clearing spots opens up new locations and hidden paths across the map.FeaturesReal ragdoll physics — every nutshot plays out in glorious, flailing slow motion.Chain reactions — fling one downed body into the next and topple a whole crowd like dominoes.Hidden secret targets — some victims are tucked where you'd never think to throw.Blocky lo-fi style — clean, colorful, low-poly worlds built to be wrecked.Achievements — complete every level, hunt down every secret, and rack up a truly absurd lifetime nutshot count.Mundane places. Zany people. Excellent aim.Plays great on Steam Deck — touch-friendly controls, pick up and throw anywhere.

games.name: One Line Wonder
games.summary: Draw every path exactly once in a relaxing collection of logic puzzles. Plan your route, connect every edge without retracing, and master increasingly intricate one-line challenges at your own pace.

games.name: Penguin Fury
games.summary: Penguin Fury is a roguelite auto-battler. Draft penguins, merge them into stronger forms, bolt on weapons and drop them into endless waves. Chain kills to climb from FRENZY to GODLIKE, unlock 70 skins across 6 eras, and push every run one wave further.

games.name: Pet Store: Tidy Up Sorting Simulator
games.summary: Tidy up, sort, and organize your very own pet store! Put pet toys, food, and accessories back on the shelves, clean up the mess, and turn a chaotic shop into a perfectly organized pet paradise!

games.name: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion
games.summary: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion is a single-player first-person shooter with fully destructible environments and large-scale physics simulation. Blast through massive swarms of AI-controlled bots and take down huge bosses. Collateral damage is just a bonus.

games.name: Pirate Treasure: Tidy Up!
games.summary: Attention, greenhorn! Prove you’re worthy of joining the crew by tidying up our chaotic treasure vault. Sort every piece of loot into its rightful place, upgrade your sluggish hands with hooks and peglegs, and discover hidden skills along the way!

games.name: PITH
games.summary: Traverse a wonderful and strange world of cubes shrouded in fog in PITH, a 3D metroidvania adventure. Find tools to help delve deeper and uncover secrets that were hiding in plain sight.

games.name: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
Priestess's Delusions
games.summary: She turned my summer into a mystical tale — a delusion that melts away like snow the moment I close my eyes.

games.name: Punch The Walls
games.summary: Locked in a cell with nothing but your fists. Punch the walls into cubes, vacuum up the rubble and shred it for cash. Upgrade, dig deeper through harder rock, and find out what the prisoners before you left behind.

games.name: Purrfectly Sorted
games.summary: Sort over 4,000 adorable kitty plushies by patterns and colors onto shelves. In this relaxing first-person experience, earn money with every completed shelf and unlock handy upgrades to help with your task. Zero stress, just pure order and satisfaction.

games.name: Ravenford: The Last Raven Warden
games.summary: Ravenford: The Last Raven Warden is a painterly dark fantasy beat 'em up. Fight through twelve cursed chapters as the last warden, chain sword combos and fiery spells, move between lanes, upgrade your blade and armor, and face monstrous bosses to free a land swallowed by night.

games.name: Rennspiel
games.summary: Up to 16 cars on one screen and no room for manners. A top-down racer in the spirit of the 16-bit era: rockets, mines and oil on the road, eight championships, 2 to 4 players on one machine on pads or the keyboard, LAN, Steam, and an editor for tracks of your own.

games.name: Retro TV Tycoon
games.summary: Take charge of a 90s television network in Retro TV Tycoon! Acquire rights for sitcoms and cult movies, schedule 24-hour broadcast grids, sign high-paying commercial sponsors, upgrade your newsroom, and expand your antenna grid to dominate the planetary airwaves.

games.name: Road Riot: Wild Rides Supporter Pack
Rockburst
games.summary: Break the support. Drop the slab. Smash the rock below. Rockburst is an incremental mining game about setting off collapses, collecting ore and buying upgrades to dig deeper before your lamp runs out.

games.name: ROLL FOR THE CROWN
games.summary: Roll through six themed racing regions, manage your ranch, train promising horses, and invest in facilities before putting every decision to the test on the track. A single-player strategy game combining board-game route planning with horse-racing management.

games.name: Roll of Chaos
games.summary: Roll the dice and embrace the chaos in an epic roguelike where every decision could save you or destroy you... Combine abilities, create unique builds, and upgrade your character with every run while facing enemies with unique powers that change every battle!

games.name: Rosaline: The Dragon Girl
games.summary: Awakening from a deadly clash with a dragon, Rosaline gains terrifying powers. Set off on an epic journey through the kingdom of Artolia, slay fearsome monsters alongside allies, and confront the corrupt shadow threatening her homeland.

games.name: Sam, We Talked About This Demo
Scared Numbers
games.summary: An atmospheric puzzle where the same numbers can be both the right answer and a mistake. Select numbers on the board, complete conditions, build sums, and solve formulas with increasing complexity.

games.name: Sidebar Sea: Idle Fishing for Your Taskbar
games.summary: Hi-Lo Havoc is a classic guessing game with a twist.  The concept seems easy enough. Guess whether the next card will be higher or lower than the last card.  Sounds simple enough, but that's where the Havoc begins.  Wildcard, Switch-a-roo or All-in havocs will randomly appear to keep you on your toes just when you think the guess is obvious.  Try to win as many coins as possible.

games.name: Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store!
games.summary: Silk Collector is a cozy organizing simulator where you shelve 4,012 scattered clothes in a magical fashion house. Shelve the clothes to collect silk, then spend it on spells that speed up the sorting. Keep an eye out for the clothes that wander the store like ghosts.

games.name: Silver Service: Tidy Up the Grand Buffet
games.summary: Silver Service is a cozy tidying game where you put 11,132 portions back where they belong aboard a cruise liner, solo or with up to 3 friends. Fill your tray, find the right display, unlock upgrades, and to unwind, grab your fishing rod and see what’s hiding under the water.

games.name: Sort Them Socks
games.summary: A cozy sorting game. A room is buried under thousands of pairs of socks, you, and 64 empty cabinets line the walls. Match every pair by colour, pattern and price, hang it on the right rod, and watch the shelves fill up one satisfying row at a time.

games.name: Sumo Dynasty
games.summary: Run a sumo stable as its oyakata. Raise young men from amateur sumo to the top of the banzuke, survive the Yokozuna Council, buy elder names and build a dynasty, in the most in-depth sumo management game ever made. In English and full Japanese.

games.name: Tactics: Setting Sun
games.summary: Tactics: Setting Sun is a turn-based strategy game centered around the Pacific Theater of World War II. Equip and command your troops as you see fit. Features multiplayer and single-player modes, an integrated map editor, and a rogue-like campaign.

games.name: Tenebrarium
games.summary: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

games.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
games.summary: Lead your small caravan on a great journey across the ancient world, in a story-driven RTS where protecting your family and friends matters more than conquest.

games.name: The Archive Project
games.summary: A gothic idle card-collecting game: open packs, complete your Album, develop your city and combine cards, talents, relics, expeditions and the Monolith to build an ever-growing economy.

games.name: The Car Dealer
games.summary: You just lost your job. All you have is an empty garage and a family counting on you. Buy cars, haggle hard, sell at a profit. But inspections can be wrong, sellers lie, and inflating your claims has a price.

games.name: The Last Wish (STD Games)
games.summary: A dead graphics card. An AI genie. Three wishes with a hidden cost. Find five differences in each of 17 illustrated scenes as Theo’s wish to escape work transforms the world around him. A relaxing puzzle game with a dark fantasy story. no timer, no penalty, just a closer look.

games.name: The Peg Mines
games.summary: The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

games.name: This Floor Is Mine
games.summary: An unfolding apocalypse will challenge your decision making as you try to keep the residents of the third floor happy and alive. Will they succumb to infighting? Or will you maintain the humanity of this small community?

games.name: Tikra Rida
games.summary: Flip used cars in Vilnius. Read the ads, meet the seller, haggle — but the ad might be lying. Buy the history report, or trust your gut. Wash it, fix it, photograph it, and sell it for more than you paid. Full Lithuanian and English.

games.name: Wild Hive
games.summary: Wild Hive is a bee colony sim driven by a ruthless honey market. Hatch workers, brew honey, and sell it well — because the quota climbs every year, and the year you miss it, your run is over. Build Your HiveLay brood cells for your queen, raise honey silos, and shape the hex grid your colony lives in. Every silo type pushes the hive's temperature, humidity, and CO₂ — your floor plan is your climate control. Build it right and brew four varieties of honey; build it wrong and cook your own bees. Forage or StarveSend workers on nectar runs, from the safety of Bluebell Woods to the rich, risky Alpine Meadows — every trip a bet on yield against the odds of coming home. Fields deplete as you strip them and refill with the seasons, so rotate your crews or fly home empty. Upgrade a favorite field for bigger stockpiles, faster flights, or a shot at Super Nectar. Play the MarketHoney has one price, and it never sits still. Ride the booms, dodge the crashes, and sell at the peak to clear the year's quota before winter runs out. Work the RAX exchange on the side — buy shares in five rival hives, pocket the dividends, and lease out idle bees for a steady cut. Survive the SeasonsYour hive breathes: temperature, humidity, and CO₂ drift with the weather and your own architecture. Let one cross the red line and bees die, honey spoils, silos crumble. When winter freezes your nectar solid, thaw it fast — or lose it. Defend the QueenWasps raid the hive. Workers drop everything and charge; you hire mercenary bees to hold the line. When the last defender falls, the wasps go for the Queen — and if she dies, so does the colony.  Hatch, feed, and put to work a swarm of autonomous bees — every one of them mortal. Grow honey silos through 9 levels and 4 types to brew 4 varieties of honey. Pin up to 3 Royal Seals a year — permanent modifiers that bend the rules of your run. Trade shares in 5 rival hives and lease out your workforce on the RAX exchange. Settle 5 biomes, from fishing the Mountain Lake to catching apples in the Juicy Orchards. Outplay a rival queen at Honeycomb Clash, or ferment your surplus into mead at the Meadery. Reach level 30, then climb 7 tiers of Wax difficulty that rewrite the rules against you. Or ignore the quota entirely in Endless mode and grow the biggest hive you can.Your first colony will collapse. Your empire starts with the next one.
